Hero_Desc_Selline:
A phantom whose hobby is making fun of others and making them angry.
Initially, she sounds friendly, but the closer you listen, the more you realize how incredibly adept she is at getting under your skin.
She considers everyone her prey, including other phantoms aside from herself, but she apparently likes to target elves above all.
Album_Like_Selline: The face of those who can't stand insults.
Album_Hobby_Selline: Taking photos of grimacing faces after taunting them.
Album_Wish_Selline: Collecting sour expressions of every Apostle.
Album_Selline1: Selene is a phantom who operates alone. Given her knack for teasing and provoking others, one might think she'd be popular among fellow phantoms, but even other phantoms find her annoying and tend to avoid her.
Album_Selline2: Every time she riles someone up, she pulls out a camera from somewhere and snaps a photo. She claims that the moments when people get mad or struggle to hold back their anger are exhilarating to capture... I have no idea what she's talking about.
Album_Selline3: Like other phantoms, Selene isn't on good terms with elementals. The one she seems to focus on the most is Gabia. No matter how much she tries to provoke her, she never reacts. But... is she really holding it all in?
Album_Selline4: When I asked how Selene figures out people's weaknesses, she leaned in and whispered that she has a special ability. If she looks into someone's eyes, she can see their weakness as an image reflected in their pupils. She stared into my eyes for a while before frowning, saying that she couldn't see anything, looking quite puzzled.
Album_Selline5: Selene has a habit of suddenly creeping up and whispering nonsense in people's ears. It gave me chills, so I told her to stop, but she doesn't seem inclined to. Considering she does it to other Apostles as well, it must just be one of her quirks.
Album_Selline6: Apparently, she plays chess from time to time. She picked up a discarded chess set somewhere in the Werebeast Forest and occasionally plays against herself. She says it helps sharpen her skills in identifying weaknesses...
Album_Selline7: Selene thinks elves make great targets for teasing. She says that just throwing out any remark gets a big, dramatic reaction, making them fun to watch. I suggested she take it easy, but she laughed and said, "With so many flaws to pick on, how could I resist?"
